_: RELEASE 0 — REHEARSAL ACCEPTANCE RECEIPT. This is NOT production. It is the receipt tools/release0/acceptance_receipt.js produced against an isolated Postgres clone that tools/step13/rehearse_release_train.js had driven through the entire release sequence B3..B13. It is preserved so the shape of the production receipt is known before the production run, and so any difference between the two is visible rather than argued.

old_writers_impossible.legacy_operator_done_path: refused (409 legacy_completion_retired) before any transaction opens
old_writers_impossible.post_cutover_closed: refused by migration 140 (R0003) regardless of which build serves

receipt.invariant_audit_note: EMPTY IS THE EXPECTED ANSWER. A row is a SYSTEM-INTEGRITY event — guard dropped, deployed late, or bypassed by privileged DDL. It is NOT a new obligation against a person: §4.2 keeps its narrow semantics and raises for one class only.
receipt.evidence_immutability: cited proof attachments are frozen entirely (R0005, immediate, UPDATE and DELETE). Proof that justified a completion is historical: correct it by adding new truth, never by rewriting the old evidence.

operator_contract.field_of_record: proof.state — one of satisfied · not_satisfied · legacy_indeterminate · missing_evaluation_defect
operator_contract.read_failure: read_status='unavailable' with state and satisfied ABSENT, never null
operator_contract.retired: proof.satisfied has left the wire; the §3.4 mapping is exported so a consumer can still derive it

outside_release_0: the full eight-fact completion transaction is the canonical service's, not the database's — 140 prevents terminal/proof divergence and protects the evidence behind that proof, and no more
a governed operator/manager completion surface (§1.1.2 — containment, not a permanent ruling)
reopening pre-cutover work — inventoried legacy status is frozen
retention / privacy / storage lifecycle for cited evidence — PARKED, and when taken up, redaction must be new truth rather than a rewrite
any scheduler: the §4.2 sweep is a governed MANUAL runner
